parts.text: Here is a table of the first seven terms of an F-type sequence. The first term F 1 is 5. The second term F 2 is 3. F 1 F 2 F 3 F 4 F 5 F 6 F 7 5 3 8 11 19 30 49 In the table, F 1 + F 2 = 5 + 3 = 8 = F 3 F 2 + F 3 = 3 + 8 = 11 = F 4 F 3 + F 4 = 8 + 11 = 19 = F 5 and so on.

content.tex: Here is a table of the first seven terms of an F-type sequence.
The first term \(F_{1}\) is 5. The second term \(F_{2}\) is 3.
Calculate the 8th term \((F_{8} )\) and the 9th term \((F_{9} ).\)
